inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject a separate preferred-GDR edge if it merely duplicates the accepted common-GDR issuer exposure; otherwise downgrade if no material demand emerges or competitive internal yield and qualification displace Samsung supply.
inputs.proposed_mechanism: Terafab and SpaceXAI may require externally supplied HBM, server memory, foundry and packaging while internal capacity is built and qualified, supporting Samsung economics before potential long-run displacement.

objective: Review whether Samsung Electronics preferred GDR has a non-redundant material causal relationship to the Terafab AI industrial stack through transitional memory, foundry and packaging demand; accept or reject the edge.
